steps.quote: Call it with the credit_card_account_id to check if there are any outstanding replacement card orders for that account.

steps.do: Decide eligibility. The customer is not eligible if any returned order is not delivered or cancelled (for example pending or shipped). Also check the tier limit on replacements within a 60-day period: Entry 2, Mid 3, Premium and above 4. If the response is empty or ambiguous, retry the call once.
steps.quote: You cannot submit another replacement while an existing request is still being processed. Wait until the current replacement is delivered or cancelled before submitting a new request.

steps.do: If not eligible, do not unlock or call order_replacement_credit_card_7291. Tell the customer the reason: a replacement is already in process (wait until it is delivered or cancelled), or the tier limit is reached. For a legitimate need beyond the limit, offer a manual review by a human agent. Transfer only if the customer agrees.
steps.if: check_eligibility found a non-final pending order or the tier replacement limit reached
steps.quote: If you believe you have a legitimate need for an additional replacement beyond these limits, contact customer support to request a manual review of your case.

steps.do: Read the primary address on file for the verified user, if it was not already read during verification.
steps.if: eligible
steps.quote: Confirm the shipping address with the customer (primary or alternate, including any unit or suite information).

steps.do: Ask whether to ship to the primary address on file or to an alternate address. If alternate, take the full address including any unit or suite and read it back for confirmation. Give out the address on file only to the verified customer.
steps.if: eligible
steps.quote: Confirm the shipping address with the customer (primary or alternate, including any unit or suite information).

steps.do: Offer standard delivery (7–10 business days, no fee) or expedited (2–3 business days). State the expedited fee for the card's tier: Entry $15.00, Mid $10.00 (Silver Rewards, Business Silver, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom), Premium and above $0.00. If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited. If a fee applies and the customer picks expedited, get their explicit consent to the fee.
steps.if: eligible
steps.quote: If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited shipping to minimize exposure and remind the customer to review recent transactions for unauthorized activity.

steps.do: Unlock the replacement order tool.
steps.if: eligible, and the customer has confirmed the address and shipping speed (and fee consent if a fee applies)
steps.quote: Use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool with tool_name: order_replacement_credit_card_7291.

steps.do: Place the replacement order. Use the parameter names the unlocked tool shows.

steps.do: If the order call returns an error or a rejection, explain the reason (pending replacement or tier limit) and what must be resolved. Do not claim the card was replaced. Offer a human agent for manual review if the customer wants one.
steps.if: order_replacement returns an error or rejection
steps.quote: If you believe you have a legitimate need for an additional replacement beyond these limits, contact customer support to request a manual review of your case.

steps.do: Tell the customer: the old card is cancelled now. The new card has a different number and CVV, and the account number stays the same. Give the delivery window (standard 7–10 business days, expedited 2–3 business days) and the address it ships to. Say emails will come when the order is placed and when the card ships.
steps.if: order_replacement succeeded
steps.quote: The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.

steps.do: If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges in the app or website. File a dispute only if the customer asks for one.
steps.if: reason is fraud_suspected or stolen
steps.quote: If the reason was fraud_suspected or stolen, remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges in the app or website.

rules.rule: Do not unlock or call order_replacement_credit_card_7291 unless the customer is eligible.
rules.quote: Confirm eligibility for replacement in the knowledge base before proceeding. Do not unlock or call the tool unless the customer is eligible. If not eligible, explain next steps per the knowledge base.

rules.rule: No new replacement while an existing one is pending or shipped. Treat any order that is not delivered or cancelled as pending.
rules.quote: Treat the account as having pending replacement activity unless every order is clearly delivered or cancelled.

rules.rule: Replacement limit per 60-day period: Entry 2, Mid 3, Premium and above 4.
rules.quote: Replacement requests are limited within a 60-day period to help protect your account.

rules.rule: Expedited fee for Mid tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card) is $10.00.
rules.quote: Mid-tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card): $10.00.

rules.rule: Expedited fee for Entry tier (Bronze Rewards Card, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards Card) is $15.00.
rules.quote: Entry-tier (Bronze Rewards Card, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards Card): $15.00.

rules.rule: Expedited shipping is free for Premium tier and above (Gold, Business Gold, Platinum, Business Platinum, Diamond Elite).
rules.quote: Premium-tier and above (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card): $0.00 (complimentary).

rules.rule: Standard delivery is free for every tier.
rules.quote: Standard delivery: 7–10 business days; free for all cardholders.

rules.rule: The shipping address may be the primary address or an alternate address the customer gives, including any unit or suite.
rules.quote: Confirm the shipping address with the customer (primary or alternate, including any unit or suite information).

rules.rule: The replacement has a new card number and CVV. The account number does not change.
rules.quote: A new card is created with a different card number and CVV.

draft.done_when: Either the replacement order succeeded and the customer has been told the old card is cancelled, the delivery window and address, the email notifications, and (for fraud_suspected or stolen) the reminder to review and dispute unauthorized charges; or the customer was told why they are not eligible and what must be resolved.
